content.title: SIGNS YOUR BODY IS QUIETLY RUNNING LOW ON {{SOMETHING}}
facts: **Iodine** – Unexplained weight gain, feeling cold all the time, brain fog, and a puffy face.
**Vitamin K** – Bruising easily, cuts that won't stop bleeding, and bleeding gums.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, blurred vision, and numbness in the hands or feet.
**Potassium** – Muscle cramps at night, heart palpitations, and constant fatigue.
**Folate** – Mouth sores, mental fog, irritability, and pale skin.
**Vitamin A** – Trouble seeing in dim light, dry eyes, and frequent infections.
**Zinc** – Slow-healing wounds, hair thinning, and a fading sense of taste or smell.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these are easy to miss because they creep in slowly. Low **iodine** throws off your thyroid, which controls how your body uses energy — that's why it can leave you feeling cold and sluggish even when nothing else has changed. Low **folate** matters because your body needs it to make new red blood cells and DNA, so a shortage shows up as brain fog and pale, tired-looking skin. And **zinc** plays a big role in cell repair, which is exactly why wounds start healing slower and your sense of taste can quietly dull. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and get labs checked if something feels off.

At @smarthealthfix we dig into nutrition, common symptoms, organ function, and small daily habits that actually move the needle. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
